description.value: The study investigated associations between childhood maltreatment severity, PTSD diagnosis, and inhibition-related brain activation during a Go/No-Go response-inhibition task in trauma-exposed African-American women, focusing on the rostral anterior cingulate cortex and exploratory whole-brain effects.

quotes: Using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), we investigated brain activation during a response inhibition task shown to engage multiple aspects of the prefrontal cortex,40 in which we previously observed a PTSD-related deficit in rACC activation.5
